logic.summary: Long-only H1 momentum model: stay long while closed bar Close[1] > Close[15]; exit flat otherwise.
logic.economic_rationale: Short-horizon directional trend persistence over 14 H1 bars (~14 trading hours).
known_assumptions: Evaluates strictly on closed H1 bars (shift 1 vs shift 15) at each new H1 bar open.
No hard SL/TP; risk exit is signal reversal (Close[1] <= Close[15]).
rejection_criteria: Net Out-of-Sample expectancy after realistic spread, swap, and slippage <= 0.
Performance collapses under +/-2 bar lookback perturbation.
